response.sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), 'Unknown') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS winners FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), 'Unknown')) SELECT hand, winners, 1.0 * winners / SUM(winners) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts ORDER BY hand;
